display.purpose: Singular burden values in the selected-neighborhood inspector.

headline.purpose: Uppercase route commands and major analytical headings.

title.purpose: Metric values and compact panel titles.

body.purpose: Readable explanatory and contextual interface copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase controls, statuses, panel coordinates, and metadata.

shadows.name: overlay-list
shadows.purpose: Separates the neighborhood result list, the system's one true overlay, from the working field.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Navigation hover and active-state color and background changes.

motion.name: inspector-rule-pulse
motion.purpose: Carries a confirmed selection across the top rule of the inspector.

motion.name: polygon-selection-pulse
motion.purpose: Briefly expands the selected neighborhood edge and fill.

motion.name: trend-marker-pulse
motion.purpose: Confirms that the annual trend synchronized to the active selection.

motion.name: loading-spin
motion.purpose: Shows active artifact loading; becomes a static selection-colored square under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion-collapse
motion.purpose: Collapses animation and transition duration when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Active Rail Navigation
components.description: A square rail destination whose tonal field and electric edge identify the active analytical station.
components.html: MAP
components.css: .ds-rail-item { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; font: 500 .64rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .1em; transition: color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-rail-item svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-rail-item:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--panel); } .ds-rail-item[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--selection); border-left-color: var(--selection); background: var(--panel-active); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-item:active { background: var(--panel-active); }

components.name: Neighborhood Search Field
components.description: The searchable neighborhood selector, with cyan orientation icon and an electric focus-within state.
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-muted); font: 600 .65rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-search-field { width: 330px; height: 46px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--panel); display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--selection); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--selection); } .ds-search-field svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-left: 12px; color: var(--support); flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-search-field input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; height: 100%; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-primary); font: 500 .9rem/1 var(--font-body); } .ds-search-field input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Selected Severity Filter
components.description: A square analytical filter that exposes its selected state with a check, border, text, and tonal field.
components.html: <button class="ds-filter-chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 12.5 4.2 4.2L19 7" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"/></svg>Serious injury</button>
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; text-transform: uppercase; font: 600 .66rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-chip svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-right: 7px; opacity: 0; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { color: var(--text-primary); border-color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--selection); border-color: var(--selection); background: var(--panel-active); } .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed="true"] svg { opacity: 1; } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-filter-chip:active { background: var(--panel-active); }

components.name: Selected Layer Tab
components.description: A panel-bar tab whose inset bottom rule identifies the selected density analysis layer.
components.css: .ds-tabs { height: 48px; display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; } .ds-tabs button { min-width: 112px; height: 100%; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font: 600 .67rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .08em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: var(--text-primary); background: var(--panel); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--panel-active); color: var(--selection); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--selection); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-tabs button:active { background: var(--panel-active); }

components.name: Metric Cell
components.description: A continuously bordered evidence cell with an operational label and tabular measured value.
components.css: .ds-metric-cell { width: 210px; min-height: 84px; margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--panel); } .ds-metric-cell dt { color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font: 500 .67rem/1.2 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-metric-cell dd { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--support); font: 600 1.75rem/1 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Partial Data Warning
components.description: A full-width tonal banner that names an incomplete period or analytical exclusion in text.
components.html: 2026 PARTIAL THROUGH AUGUST 31 · EXCLUDED FROM COMPARISON
components.css: .ds-warning { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--caution) 48%, var(--border)); background: var(--caution-soft); color: var(--caution); text-transform: uppercase; font: 600 .65rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .1em; }

components.name: Primary Burden Panel
components.description: The selected neighborhood's headline evidence panel, using electric blue only for the active burden value.
components.css: .ds-burden { width: 330px; min-height: 126px; padding: 17px 20px 18px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-content: center; gap: 5px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--selection) 5%, var(--panel)); } .ds-burden span { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--text-muted); font: 600 .65rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-burden strong { color: var(--selection); font: 600 3.55rem/.86 var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-burden small { align-self: end; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 .7rem/1.3 var(--font-body); text-align: right; }

components.name: Map Panel Coordinate Bar
components.description: A hairline-bound coordinate bar that pairs scope metadata with the active map metric.
components.css: .ds-panel-bar { width: 520px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 13px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font: 500 .62rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-panel-bar strong { color: var(--selection); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The Civic Safety Operations Console treats each screen as a calibrated public instrument rather than a consumer dashboard. A near-black navy field, condensed operational labels, restrained body copy, and tabular numerics give dense evidence a precise control-room cadence while keeping the public data legible.

Panels stay flat and rectilinear, separated by blue-gray hairlines and small tonal steps instead of decorative lift. Electric blue tracks the active selection across controls, maps, and evidence; cyan supports analysis, amber marks caution or partial data, and red appears only for genuine fatal outcomes.
keyCharacteristics: Square modules with hairline structural borders.
Condensed uppercase labels paired with restrained sans-serif body copy.
Semantic accents whose meanings remain stable across views.
One synchronized selection pulse, removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Selection Has One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Electric blue means active or selected; do not spend it on generic decoration.

rules.name: The Severity Color Rule
rules.body: Amber communicates caution or incomplete evidence, while red is reserved for fatalities, errors, and worsening safety outcomes.

rules.name: The Condensed Means Operational Rule
rules.body: Use the display face for commands, labels, navigation, and numbers; never set explanatory paragraphs in it.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone and hairline structure before shadow; shadow is reserved for content that physically overlays another working layer.

rules.name: The Rectilinear Rule
rules.body: Keep corners between 0px and 2px in implemented primitives; never soften the console with pill controls or generic rounded cards.

dos: Do keep evidence dense, aligned, and divided by one-pixel blue-gray hairlines.
Do use Electric Selection consistently for the active route, filter, polygon, or analytical layer.
Do pair uppercase condensed labels with restrained body copy and tabular numeric values.
Do label partial data and analytical exclusions in text as well as color.
Do preserve 40–44px touch targets and visible keyboard focus at every responsive size.
donts: Don't introduce glassmorphism, backdrop blur, or ambient shadows on resting surfaces.
Don't turn controls into pills or panels into generic rounded cards.
Don't use Fatal Outcome Red for neutral emphasis or decorative heat.
Don't create oversized marketing heroes; the first viewport is a working evidence field.
Don't reintroduce Streamlit styling, friendly dashboard defaults, or ornamental control-room machinery.
